# roadie_action (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_action" "existing" {
  slug = "list-repositories"
}

output "action_enabled" {
  value = data.roadie_action.existing.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier. Provide either id or slug.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifier. Provide either id or slug.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `current_version` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `effective_mode` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `input_schema` (String) The computed JSON Schema for action inputs.
- `mode` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
